name: Rewardix – Mystery Scratch Coupon for WooCommerce
author: Raihan

sections.description:
Transform your WooCommerce store with an interactive scratch-to-reveal discount system featuring advanced analytics, intelligent targeting, and automated marketing campaigns. This plugin includes powerful premium features designed to maximize conversions and revenue.

Key Features

  • Dashboard with Charts: Real-time analytics and insights including revenue generated, conversion rates, and popular rewards.
  • Revenue Attribution: Track the direct impact of coupons on yours sales and calculate ROI for each reward.
  • Tiered Rewards: Set rewards based on cart value to encourage higher spending.
  • Time-Based Rewards: Schedule different rewards for weekdays, weekends, or specific hours.
  • Weighted Probability: Control the distribution of rewards by setting custom weights.
  • Limited Quantity Rewards: Create urgency by setting daily limits per reward.
  • Follow-Up Email Campaigns: Automatically send reminder emails to recover unused coupons.
  • Product/Category Restrictions: Target specific products/categories for scratch card display.
  • Customer Group Targeting: Personalize experiences for guest users, new customers, returning customers, or VIPs.
  • Business Hours Scheduling: Control when the scratch card appears based on allowed days and hours.
  • Usage Limits: Set maximum lifetime plays per customer to prevent abuse.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the mystery-scratch-coupon-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through WordPress admin
  3. Navigate to Mystery Scratch Coupon in the admin menu
  4. Configure your rewards and settings
  5. The scratch card will automatically appear on your checkout page (or via shortcode)
sections.faq:
How do I display the scratch card manually?

You can use the [mystery_scratch_card] shortcode to place the card anywhere on your site.

Can I restrict rewards to specific products?

Yes, you can configure product and category restrictions in the settings.

Does it work with the VIP customers?

Yes, you can set a revenue threshold to automatically identify and target VIP customers.
